findings.summary: Repeated per-row labels (savings, deposits 0%, shares, FX, 3/5 years) make scanning for differences tedious
Company name only in group header that scrolls away; lower rows can't be tied to a company
143 near-identical rows with no guidance on which track suits the reader
Many tracks show 'less than 3 years' instead of a return figure, so they can't be compared
Exposure ring colours explained only by tiny dots; FX (מט"ח) term unexplained
Fees shown only in percent, not shekels, so differences feel negligible
'Not yet reported' with orange warning icon on new tracks looks alarming and is unexplained
Sticky column headers small, grey, and far from the numbers
